text: Life doesn't feel worth living anymore.
I feel like giving up on everything.
I don't see any hope for my future.
I feel like everyone would be better off without me.
I don't know if I can keep going.
Everything feels completely hopeless.
I feel emotionally exhausted and empty.
I don't think life will ever get better.
I feel like there is no point in anything anymore.
I can't see a future for myself.
I feel completely broken inside.
I don't know how much longer I can cope.
I feel like I've lost all hope.
Nothing seems to matter anymore.
I feel like I'm trapped with no way out.
Every day feels harder than the last.
I don't believe things will improve for me.
I feel completely overwhelmed by life.
I don't know how to keep moving forward.
I wish this emotional pain would stop.
